Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator produced the final answer by (1) incorrectly treating the observed p-value of 0.04 as the expected false-positive rate/Type I error (a conceptual error, since p-values are not the probability a claim is false nor the false discovery rate), and (2) multiplying by an unverified guess of 1500 Nature research articles instead of obtaining the actual 2020 count. These compounded assumptions led directly to the incorrect solution of 60.
